tools.name: Web search
tools.description: Searches the public web and returns pages with citable passages.
tools.setup: Anthropic's server-side web search tool. Turn on with WORKFLOWS_WEB_SEARCH=on; searches are billed by Anthropic.

tools.name: Web fetch
tools.description: Reads specific public web pages (GET only) and returns their readable text and metadata.
tools.setup: Built in, runs on this computer. Turn on with WORKFLOWS_WEB_FETCH=on. Public addresses only: private, local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused.
